exact_reduction: Every two-bit Boolean gate is constant, a dictator, parity-equivalent, or point-defect-equivalent. Only the point-defect class is nontrivial.

point_defect_parameters.p: probability of the exceptional value of the revealed bit
point_defect_parameters.q: probability of the exceptional value of the unrevealed bit

analytic_boundaries: p down to 0 with fixed q, including the unique saturating q=1/4
p up to 1 with fixed q
q down to 0 and q up to 1 with fixed p
proof_status: Endpoint asymptotics proved; finite pilot numerical only; full interior continuum remains open.
next_certificate_target: Prove D(p,q)<=0 on a compact interior rectangle and close the joint q->0,1 corners, using signed rational log intervals or an analytic monotonicity decomposition.
